title: Generate amorphous SiO2 sample via melt-quench
action: Using LAMMPS and the modified BKS potential, create an initial amorphous SiO2 configuration of 1536 atoms at 300 K. Start from a β-cristobalite crystal, melt at 5000 K, and cool to 300 K over 470 ps in the NVT ensemble.
description: Prepares the amorphous starting structure required for all subsequent simulations.

title: Volumetric loading-unloading MD and densification threshold data
action: Using the amorphous configuration from Step 1, perform volumetric compression–unloading cycles at 300 K. Choose at least 4 distinct maximum pressures between 0 and 15 GPa. For each cycle, compress the sample to the target pressure and then unload. Record pressure (GPa) and normalised volume.
description: Pressure‑volume data from loading‑unloading cycles. The verifier will compute residual volume change to identify the irreversible densification threshold.
output_schema: csv columns: cycle_id (int), loading_phase (str: 'load'/'unload'), volume_norm (float, dimensionless), pressure (float, GPa)

title: Pressure-shear MD, critical-state line, and relaxation envelope
action: Using the amorphous configuration from Step 1, for at least 6 confining pressures (tensile to compressive, e.g. −1 to +12 GPa) prepare the sample by over‑consolidation (compress to 50 GPa then unload to target) and apply shear to a steady plateau. Record confining pressure and plateau shear stress. The verifier will from these data fit the critical-state line model AND solve the rank-2 envelope equations to verify the relaxed (macroscopic) critical-state line parameters (r, s, p_min, p_max) against the paper-reported values.
description: Critical state points (confining pressure, critical shear stress). The verifier fits a two‑branch model to extract the critical‑state line parameters and computes the rank‑2 envelope for the relaxed effective line.
output_schema: csv columns: confining_pressure (float, GPa), critical_shear_stress_qc (float, GPa)
